name: Yukon
description: Almost all Cordillera: the St. Elias icefields and Kluane in the south-west, plateaus and the Yukon River valley in the centre (Whitehorse, Dawson), the Ogilvie and Mackenzie mountains to the east, and the Arctic coastal plain in the far north.

highest_point.name: Mount Logan (St. Elias Mountains; highest point in Canada)
